mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM role_permission rp JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = false
SELECT DISTINCT r.scope_type FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = false
